Advances: specled.realized_by

RESCOPED 2026-07-24 (board triage vs HEAD a509836). Original headline — hashes are compile-context-sensitive — is contradicted by the 2026-07-23 corpus finding below: standing drift is STALE-BASELINE, not env-sensitivity. The July 10 fixes (ab5beb6 wholesale-drift-after-reseed, 1a837d3 seed-world parity, c228bff HashStore merge preserves impl baseline) very likely resolved the original detector-vs-seed disagreement. 0.4.0 added --accept-drift and 8e91b13 (o40) fixed the api_boundary position leak.

Corpus finding (frozen at ~/Documents/my-vault/LLMs/corpora/atlas-l05-snapshot-2026-07-23, Atlas a1e9c670 @ spec_led_ex ca9cec8): macOS and CI drift sets IDENTICAL (130 findings: 53 api_boundary + 77 implementation) at same SHA + same toolchain (Elixir 1.19.5/OTP 28); 668/798 entries provably hash identical cross-env. Historical env-sensitivity evidence (dep-bump flip 433a366d, pre-vmi-reseed 46a4b2af) predates the July 10 fixes and must be re-reproduced before being believed.

Remaining work, in order:
1. ATTRIBUTION STUDY (maintainer, cross-repo): re-run the dep-bump/clean-recompile experiment against the frozen corpus on current specled main. Best done inside the planned Atlas >=0.4.x dep-bump PR that absorbs one-time o40 drift anyway. If mechanisms no longer reproduce, items 2-3 shrink to test-and-close.
2. CROSS-COMPILE DETERMINISM TEST: none exists — implementation_tier.spec.md:134-141 scopes deterministic_hashes to no-recompilation runs; implementation_test.exs:668-720 covers same-process repeats only. Add integration test: compile --force twice + two MIX_ENVs, hashes byte-identical. Amend the spec requirement.
3. HASH-INPUT AUDIT: two unaudited context-sensitivity vectors — (a) BEAM-vs-source AST shape divergence in realization/binding.ex (beam clause form :304-309 vs full source def node :393-429, selected by fallback :222-249); (b) closure-membership dependence on merge-on-flush tracer-manifest history + manifest-keyed in_project_set (implementation.ex:454-548).

Exit criterion unchanged: branch_guard_realization_drift on the implementation tier can graduate warning->error for consumers (or baseline becomes CI-seeded by convention).

Evidence from the specled_-hj4 ship pipeline (2026-07-25): this signature fired 3 times across merge gates today (hj4.1 gate x2, hj4.3 gate x1; latest seed 714928). Each time it failed inside a full spec.check tagged_tests run and passed on targeted re-run with the exact printed seed, in isolation, and across the whole test/integration/ dir. It is now repeatedly costing merge-gate reruns in the ship pipeline, which raises its priority beyond the original attribution study.
